root_cause: Merchant Category Code (MCC) misclassification in gateway configuration leading to higher pricing.
diagnosis: The merchant's transactions are incurring interchange downgrades because the gateway configuration does not match the registered B2B wholesale MCC 5045. Note that comparison figures use an illustrative modeled benchmark.
action_rationale: Updating the gateway configuration to the correct registered MCC 5045 will align processing fees with standard B2B wholesale interchange rates.
